benchmark.notice: Scores are rebuilt from versioned result evidence. Open a Solution for its method notes, code, and provenance.

tasks.title: Modern IR PDF Retrieval v1
tasks.description: Retrieve whole PDF documents from bilingual queries across generated layouts, scans, screenshots, annotations, compression, and camera-capture conditions.

tasks.title: Modern IR Ranked Retrieval v2.2
tasks.description: Bilingual synthetic retrieval with independent Chinese and English candidate pools and an expanded binary relevance set.

solutions.title: BGE-M3 dense · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Pinned BGE-M3 dense embeddings over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: The dense and learned-sparse Solutions share one pinned BGE-M3 encoder at revision 5617a9f61b028005a4858fdac845db406aefb181. They use the model's dedicated corpus and query encoding paths and reproduce both vector families from the same inference pass.

solutions.title: BM25 · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Milvus BM25 over shared chunks, collapsed to document rankings.
solutions.readme_preview: The full-document and chunked BM25 Solutions use Milvus built-in BM25 with an English analyzer for English pools and a Chinese analyzer for Chinese pools. The Task keeps the two language candidate pools independent.

solutions.title: BM25 · full document
solutions.description: Milvus BM25 over full documents with language-specific analyzers.
solutions.readme_preview: The full-document and chunked BM25 Solutions use Milvus built-in BM25 with an English analyzer for English pools and a Chinese analyzer for Chinese pools. The Task keeps the two language candidate pools independent.

solutions.title: BM25 + Qwen3 Embedding 8B · RRF
solutions.description: Fuse BM25 and Qwen3 Embedding 8B Top-50 document rankings with equal-weight RRF.
solutions.readme_preview: This hybrid Solution prepares the shared 768-token chunks twice: Milvus BM25 provides lexical ranks and Qwen3 Embedding 8B provides dense semantic ranks. For each query it retrieves the Top 50 documents from both components and fuses them with equal-weight reciprocal rank fusion using a rank constant of 60.

solutions.title: BM25 + Qwen3 Embedding 8B · Weighted 25/75
solutions.description: Fuse min-max normalized BM25 and Qwen3 Embedding 8B Top-50 scores with 25/75 weights.
solutions.readme_title: BM25 + Qwen3 Embedding 8B · Weighted score fusion
solutions.readme_preview: This hybrid family retrieves the Top 50 documents independently with Milvus BM25 and Qwen3 Embedding 8B over the shared 768-token chunks. Within each query, the two score lists are independently min-max normalized and then combined with fixed BM25/dense weights. Milvus exposes its BM25 relevance as a distance where lower values rank first, while cosine similarity ranks higher values first; the normalization preserves those respective directions.

solutions.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Pinned local text-only EmbeddingGemma 2 over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: This lightweight local dense Solution pins google/embeddinggemma-2 to revision 914f7f89142e33e77833254d9c9b90c3cef7303b. Only its text encoder is loaded. Queries and documents use the model's SearchQuery and Document prompt routes, then Milvus performs exact cosine search over 768-dimensional vectors generated from the benchmark-wide shared chunks.

solutions.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 · page images
solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with local EmbeddingGemma 2, then collapse to documents.
solutions.readme_preview: This OCR-free visual Solution pins google/embeddinggemma-2 to revision 914f7f89142e33e77833254d9c9b90c3cef7303b. It loads the text and vision encoders, renders every PDF page with the benchmark's shared renderer, embeds page images, and embeds queries with the model's SearchQuery prompt route. Milvus performs exact cosine search over 768-dimensional vectors, after which page hits are collapsed to whole-document rankings.

solutions.title: Gemini Embedding 2 · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Gemini Embedding 2 over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: This managed dense Solution uses google/gemini-embedding-2 through OpenRouter. Documents and queries use the API's search_document and search_query input types, respectively. Documents use the benchmark-wide 768-token chunks, and Milvus performs exact cosine search over native 3072-dimensional vectors.

solutions.title: Gemini Embedding 2 · page images
solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with Gemini Embedding 2, then collapse to documents.
solutions.readme_preview: This OCR-free visual Solution renders each PDF page with the benchmark's shared renderer and sends page images to google/gemini-embedding-2 through OpenRouter. Text queries and page images share one native 3072-dimensional space. Milvus performs exact cosine search over pages before page hits are collapsed to unique document rankings.

solutions.title: Llama Nemotron Embed VL 1B V2 · page images
solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with Llama Nemotron Embed VL 1B V2, then collapse to documents.
solutions.readme_title: Llama Nemotron Embed VL 1B V2 · page images
solutions.readme_preview: This OCR-free visual Solution renders each PDF page with the benchmark's shared renderer and sends page images to nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2:free through OpenRouter. Text queries and page images share one native 2048-dimensional space. Milvus performs exact cosine search over pages before page hits are collapsed to unique document rankings.

solutions.title: Ovis Omni Embedding 3B · page images
solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with local Ovis Omni Embedding 3B, then collapse to documents.
solutions.readme_preview: This self-hosted visual Solution uses the pinned Apache-2.0 ATH-MaaS/Ovis-Omni-Embedding-3B checkpoint. It follows the model's native Qwen2.5-Omni processor and chat template, removes the unused language-modeling head and audio tower after loading, takes the last non-padding hidden state, and L2-normalizes the resulting native 2048-dimensional vector.

solutions.description: OCR every page, embed each complete document with local BGE-M3, then search with Milvus FLAT.

solutions.readme_preview: This Solution keeps the PDF understanding stage identical to the BM25 baseline and changes only retrieval.

solutions.title: Perplexity Embed V1 4B · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Perplexity Embed V1 4B over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: This managed dense Solution uses perplexity/pplx-embed-v1-4b through OpenRouter. Documents and queries use the API's search_document and search_query input types, respectively. Documents use the benchmark-wide 768-token chunks, and Milvus performs exact cosine search over native 2560-dimensional vectors.

solutions.title: Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Pinned local Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.

Queries use the same web-search instruction as the existing 4B Solution. Documents use the shared benchmark chunks, and Milvus performs exact cosine search over 1024-dimensional vectors.

solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with local WeMM Embedding 2B, then collapse to documents.
